name: Done-for-you UNFI/KeHE + Walmart deduction recovery for $3-30M Midwest food & beverage brands (contingency)
summary: Customer = brand account. Recurring revenue = contingency fee on ongoing recovered invalid deductions; one-time revenue = fee on the retroactive backlog recovered in the first months. Deduction analysts are hired per active brands. Fee levels are unpublished across the market, so ARPC is the weakest-evidenced driver. Operating profit is before founder pay.
evidence_notes: Deductions: 1-5% of revenue (SPS, Confido) [D, DG-S053, C9-S009]; 3-8% of gross sales (UCS citing RVCF) [D, DG-S052]. Invalid share 30-60% (Confido) [D]; 65-80% of shortage claims (RVCF via UCS) [D].
Win rates: Clairelist reports 68% of UNFI disputes won, 41 days to repayment [D, DG-S050]; Confido 50-70% for documented shortages [D, C9-S009]; SPS cites 75% recovery [D, DG-S053].

Fees: no supplier-side deduction firm publishes a contingency %, including SPS, Threecolts, Upstream (UCS), Glimpse [D, DG-S051/S054/S055/S056]. Adjacent Amazon FBA reimbursement services publish 'starting at 20%' [B, DG-S057]. A UNFI-only service advertises $0 fees [D, DG-S050]. Base fee 20% is E.

Windows: UNFI 12 months (Clairelist) vs ~30-60 days (Stage C source) - conflicting [D]; KeHE ~180 days [D, C9-S011]; big-box 30-90 days [D, DG-S052]; post-audit claims arrive 18-24 months later [D, DG-S052].

Base brand: $8M gross retail sales x 3% deductions x 35% invalid x 60% recovered = $50.4k/yr recovered; 20% fee = $10.1k/yr (~$840/month). Backlog: ~6 months of recoverable history at first engagement = $25k recovered -> $5k one-time fee (E).
Competition: SPS Commerce (EDI incumbent) offers free audits and flat-fee-per-retailer or take-rate pricing [D, C9-S010, DG-S054]; Glimpse targets $1-30M brands [D, DG-S056].

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Build UNFI/KeHE code library, dispute templates, engagement letter; no licence [E].
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Free review in days, then disputes; Clairelist reports 41 days to repayment [D, DG-S050]; Threecolts first recovery within 4 weeks [D, DG-S055].
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Founder/finance conversations at Midwest emerging brands (25 named prospects, DG-S059/S061) plus broker/3PL/fractional-CFO referrals; estimate.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Brand shares a remittance/deduction export for a free review; estimate (free reviews are market norm [D, C9-S010, DG-S050]).
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Review -> signed contingency engagement; depressed by free and SaaS alternatives; estimate.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Brands churn when they hire an AR analyst, adopt SPS/Glimpse, fail or are acquired; estimate.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: cons: $6M x 2.5% x 30% x 50% x 15% fee /12; base: $8M x 3% x 35% x 60% x 20% /12; opt: $12M x 3.5% x 40% x 65% x 22% /12 (plus small retainer). Inputs D [DG-S050/S052/S053, C9-S009]; fee E.
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Retroactive backlog inside remaining dispute windows (UNFI 12 months per DG-S050; KeHE ~180 days C9-S011); conflicting UNFI window evidence lowers the conservative case.
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: Brand sales growth lifts deduction volume; offset by root-cause fixes that reduce invalid deductions.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Analyst labor is modeled as staff; direct costs = document retrieval, storage, OCR/AI per account.
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Payment processing, fee disputes, broker referral thank-yous.
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Founder review time is unpaid; travel/samples; estimate.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Midwest trade events, content on UNFI/KeHE codes; estimate.
drivers.dso_days__source: Fee invoiced after repayment/credit lands, net-15/30.

overhead.item: Software: AI document parsing/classification, OCR, storage

transactions.name: Ongoing month for an $8M brand (UNFI + KeHE)
transactions.notes: Contribution ~$605; fee = 20% of $4.2k/month recovered (E). Analyst cost sits in staff in the model.

transactions.name: Retroactive backlog sweep at onboarding
transactions.notes: Contribution ~$3,600; fee paid only as UNFI/KeHE repay (Clairelist reports 41 days) [D, DG-S050].

transactions.name: Small $3M brand, UNFI only
transactions.notes: Contribution ~$115/month: $3M x 3% x 35% x 60% x 20% / 12. Confirms Stage C finding that sub-$5M brands are not worth serving by hand.

transactions.name: Walmart OTIF / compliance fine dispute (single claim)
transactions.notes: Fee 20% of a $3,000 reversed fine; Walmart OTIF fine framed as a 3% charge by UCS [D, DG-S051].
